result.answer: If Records Out only needed the current placement (W1: its category set to current state instead of history of record), this case would close with nothing sent and no escalation. The patient records system already shows the patient in WARD-C at version 2, from the 09:45 UTC transfer. Systems that read only the current location would see the right ward. The WARD-B stay at 09:20 UTC would just never appear in the history. The real danger either way is resending the old transfer, which would move the patient back to WARD-B. The site's effect contracts say that puts the wrong bed on the bed board, sends medicines to the wrong ward and sends porters for a patient who has already moved. Under today's setting, the correction should add WARD-B only as a past movement and keep WARD-C current. If the correction cancelled and replayed the later transfer, systems told about every move might see extra moves. That is my inference. Shutter can check only the records system itself, not the systems that read it.
